body_json.prompt: Write a message to a new classmate. Tell them your name, your country, your age, and where you live now in Syria.
body_json.prompt_ar: اكتب رسالة لرفيقك الجديد بالصف. قله شو اسمك، من أي بلد أنت، قديش عمرك، ووين عايش هلق بألمانيا.
body_json.example_answer: Hello! My name is Rami. I am from Syria. I am twenty-six years old. Now, I live in Damascus, Syria. I am a student here. Nice to meet you!

body_json.prompt: Write about your family. Talk about your parents, your brothers, or your sisters. Where do they live?
body_json.prompt_ar: اكتب عن عيلتك. احكي عن أبوك وأمك، أو أخواتك الشباب والبنات. وين هنن عايشين؟
body_json.example_answer: My family is nice. I have a father and a mother. I have one brother. His name is Ali. They live in Damascus, Syria. I love my family very much.

body_json.prompt: Write about your new apartment in Syria. Describe your room and what color it is. Do you like it?
body_json.prompt_ar: اكتب عن شقتك الجديدة بألمانيا. اوصف غرفتك وشو لونها. عاجبتك؟
body_json.example_answer: I have a new apartment in Aleppo. My room is small and clean. The walls are white. I have a big brown desk. I like my new home every day.

body_json.prompt: Write about what you do every morning. What time do you wake up? What do you eat or drink?
body_json.prompt_ar: اكتب شو عم تعمل كل يوم الصبح. بأي ساعة بتفيق؟ شو بتاكل أو بتشرب؟
body_json.example_answer: Every morning, I wake up at seven o'clock. I drink hot black tea. I eat warm bread with cheese. Then, I go to my language school. I walk there.

body_json.prompt: Write about your trip to the supermarket. What food do you need to buy for dinner tonight? How much does it cost?
body_json.prompt_ar: اكتب عن مشوارك على السوبرماركت. شو بدك تشتري أكل للعشا الليلة؟ قديش حقه؟
body_json.example_answer: Today, I go to the big supermarket. I buy fresh chicken and yellow rice. I buy five red tomatoes. The food costs ten euros. I cook dinner for my friends.

body_json.prompt: Write about how you travel to your language school. What color is the bus or train? Is the ticket cheap?
body_json.prompt_ar: اكتب كيف عم تروح عمدرستك تبع اللغة. شو لون الباص أو المترو؟ هل التكت رخيص؟
body_json.example_answer: Every morning, I take the blue bus to school. The bus is always on time. The ticket costs three euros. It is very cheap. I love public transport here.

body_json.prompt: Write about the numbers in your classroom. How many students are there? How many men, women, and books do you see?
body_json.prompt_ar: اكتب عن الأرقام بصفك. كم طالب وطالبة فيه؟ كم زلمة ومرّة وكم كتاب شايف؟
body_json.example_answer: My class is big. We have twelve international students. There are four men and eight women. We have fifteen new books on the tables. Our class starts at nine.

body_json.prompt: Write about the weather today in your city. Is it cold or hot? What clothes do you wear outside?
body_json.prompt_ar: اكتب عن الجو اليوم بمدينتك. هل هو بارد ولا شوب؟ شو عم تلبس ثياب برّا؟
body_json.example_answer: The winter here is very cold. The sky is dark grey today. It is raining outside. I wear my heavy black coat and boots. I carry a yellow umbrella.

body_json.prompt: Write about your favorite cafe in the city. Where is it? What do you order there and who do you talk to?
body_json.prompt_ar: اكتب عن قهوتك المفضلة بالمدينة. وين صايرة؟ شو عم تطلب هنيك ومع مين عم تحكي؟
body_json.example_answer: I go to a small cafe near my flat. It is very beautiful. I order hot coffee and a sweet cake. I talk to my Syrian friend, Ahmad.

body_json.prompt: Write a short email to your new flatmate before you move in. Greet them, state your age, your hobbies, and what language you speak.
body_json.prompt_ar: اكتب إيميل قصير لرفيق سكنك الجديد قبل ما تنقل. سلم عليه، وقله قديش عمرك، شو هواياتك، وشو اللغة يلي بتحكيها.
body_json.example_answer: Hello Jonas! I am your new flatmate. I am twenty-five years old. I speak Arabic and English. I like football and hot coffee. See you on Sunday morning!
